candidate_program.name: local_collectible_ratio
candidate_program.rationale: Normalizes reward by a blend of feasible greedy and cover estimates of collectible neighboring weight, with a small duration-efficiency term. Both estimates remain one-hop and cannot distinguish the saved nonlocal witness; dense neighborhoods may make these local algorithms costly.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.75 * max(0, neighbor_greedy_weight) + 0.25 * max(0, neighbor_cover_weight)) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + max(0, duration))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
